Projects

Research

IOL optical test bench

Bascom Palmer Eye Institute
Summer 2026

A test bench for advanced intraocular lenses. It measures how multifocal and extended-depth-of-focus lenses perform when they sit off-center, including MTF, halos, and aberrations. I designed it in CAD and 3D printed the parts, with an off-axis parabolic mirror collimating the beam. I also designed a five-axis remote-center-of-motion stage to position the lenses.

Fusion 360, 3D printing, optics

Retinal perfusion study

Bascom Palmer Eye Institute
Spring–Summer 2024

Analyzed OCT retinal scans for a clinical study of retinal perfusion, and helped write up the results. The work is published: Zhou et al., Choriocapillaris Density Remains Constant in Healthy Older Adults After 24 Weeks of High-Speed Circuit Training, Current Eye Research (2025).

OCT image analysis

Personal builds

Useless box

Arduino

A box with one switch. Flip it on and an arm comes out to flip it back off. The first version used only switches wired to a motor. The Arduino version drives the motor through an H-bridge, and a state machine sequences the lid and arm. Try the small one at the top of this page.

Arduino, C++, H-bridge motor control

Solar charger

Personal project

A solar charger that powers a phone. The solar cell is wired in parallel with a voltage source and feeds a charging module, which supplies the phone.

Blackjack

Python

A blackjack game with a terminal version and a graphical version. I built it to learn Python after starting in C++.

About

I'm at Stanford, majoring in electrical engineering and physics (class of 2029). Over two summers at Bascom Palmer Eye Institute I worked on retinal imaging and optical instruments for eye research.

Long term, I want to build exoskeletons controlled through brain-machine interfaces, for places people can't easily go: underwater, high altitude, and space.

Outside of class I compete on Stanford's climbing team. I sailed at the national and international level, including several ILCA Youth Worlds Championships.
